snippet.title: Dixotomia - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
Step into a dystopian sci-fi world and face the darkness head-on.

Dixotomia is a VR shooter where you become an elite soldier battling a vampire cult and its powerful leaders in brutal, fast-paced combat.

Use futuristic weapons and supernatural powers to uncover the secrets of a distant planet.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1367710/Dixotomia/

🩸 About the Game

🧛 Brutal Enemies
• Fight bloodthirsty vampires and shadow masters
• Face cultists, androids, and mercenaries

🔫 Sci-Fi Arsenal
• Combine futuristic weapons with supernatural powers
• Customize your playstyle through deep upgrade systems

🌌 Immersive Story
• Explore a distant colony on the brink of collapse
• Uncover the secrets behind a mysterious cult

👑 Boss Battles
• Face powerful bosses with evolving mechanics
• Each encounter tests skill, reflexes, and strategy

🎥 Cinematic Action
• Fast-paced combat with intense and dynamic sequences
• Designed to keep adrenaline high at all times

🌍 Diverse Locations
• Explore industrial complexes, laboratories, and alien landscapes
• Each area offers unique challenges and atmosphere

⚠️ Content Warning
This game contains scenes of combat with blood effects and themes involving violence and dark elements.
